quickAnswerTitle: How Idaho School Calendars Differ in 2026–27
quickAnswer: Idaho does not use one statewide student calendar. Boise School District and West Ada School District both begin K–12 classes August 12, 2026, but their first-day schedules, preschool dates, conference closures, professional-learning days, and last days differ. Boise ends K–11 classes May 21; West Ada ends May 20.
about:
Idaho public school calendars are published locally, so families need the calendar for their district, grade level, and program. The reviewed Boise and West Ada calendars happen to share an August 12 K–12 opening, but the schedules are not interchangeable.

Boise School District marks the first day as an early-release day and starts Pre-K and ECSE on August 17. Its conference and no-school rules vary across Pre-K, elementary, junior high, and high school students. West Ada marks August 12 as a late-start day, distinguishes K–8 closures from grades 9–12 conference schedules, and publishes separate resources for preschool and secondary A/B calendars.

Use the district page for complete attendance dates, official sources, and one-time calendar downloads. Check the school schedule for exact bell times, transportation-based early release, A/B rotation, testing, athletics, graduation, and campus events.

faqs.q: Are Idaho school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Idaho districts publish their own calendars, so first days, breaks, conference closures, professional-learning days, and last days can differ.

faqs.q: When do Boise and West Ada schools start in 2026?
faqs.a: Both reviewed calendars list August 12, 2026, as the K–12 first day. Boise uses an early-release schedule, while West Ada identifies a late-start day.

faqs.q: When is Idaho Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.a: There is no single statewide Spring Break. Both reviewed district calendars list March 15–19, 2027, but families should still verify the assigned district and program calendar.

faqs.q: Do Boise and West Ada use the same conference schedule?
faqs.a: No. The reviewed calendars use different grade-band rules. A date with no classes for Boise elementary students or West Ada K–8 students may still be a school or conference day for secondary students.

faqs.q: When does school resume after Winter Break?
faqs.a: Both reviewed districts resume January 5, 2027, after a January 4 teacher-directed, professional-development, or preparation day.

faqs.q: Can I add an Idaho school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. Reviewed district pages provide an ICS file that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. It is a one-time import, not a live district subscription.
